The Problem

## "I Tried Google Ads. It Didn't Work."

We hear this constantly. The ads weren't the problem — the setup was. Here's what usually went wrong:

### Geo-Targeting Set Wrong

Google defaults to "interested in" your area — showing ads to people 500 miles away. You're paying for clicks that will never walk through your door.

### No Negative Keywords

Your ads show for grooming jobs, grooming schools, DIY tips, and pet supplies. None of those searchers are booking appointments.

### Broad Match Everything

Google's default lets your ads trigger on "how to groom a dog at home." You're paying for people who will never hire a groomer.

### No Conversion Tracking

If you can't see which clicks become phone calls and bookings, you're flying blind. Most DIY setups skip this entirely.

Our Approach

## AI-Optimized Campaign Management

Every campaign is built from our grooming-specific playbook, then continuously optimized by our AI monitoring systems.

### Precision Geo-Targeting

Ads shown ONLY to people physically within driving distance. PRESENCE targeting, not Google's default "interested in" setting that leaks budget.

### Call-Only Mobile Campaigns

When someone searches "dog groomer near me" on their phone, our ads go straight to a phone call. Skip the website, book the appointment.

### 500+ Groomer Negatives

Our proprietary negative keyword list blocks jobs, schools, DIY, supplies, and dozens of other waste terms — built from managing groomer campaigns daily.

### Full Conversion Tracking

Phone calls, form submissions, online bookings — every action tracked back to the exact ad and keyword. Know your cost per booked client, not just cost per click.

### Seasonal Budget Intelligence

AI-driven spend adjustments — increase during peak demand (spring, pre-holiday), pull back when you're booked out. Never waste budget when you can't take clients.

### Daily AI Monitoring

Automated alerts for CPC spikes, impression share drops, wasted spend, and anomalies. Problems caught in hours, not weeks.

## Straight Talk About Google Ads

### Ads Work When:

*   Your grooming is solid and clients love you
*   You have capacity for new appointments
*   You answer the phone or return calls quickly
*   Your prices are competitive for your market

### Ads Won't Fix:

*   Terrible reviews or reputation issues
*   Prices way above market rate
*   No one answering the phone
*   Serious salon quality problems

We'll tell you honestly during the audit whether ads make sense for your situation. If they don't, we'll say so.
